VendorBankDetails.ifscOrSwiftRequired: Provide at least IFSC (domestic) or SWIFT (international)
VendorBankDetails.title: Bank Details
VendorBankDetails.subtitle: Required for receiving payouts from your sales.
VendorBankDetails.incompleteWarningDesc: Without verified bank details, payout requests cannot be processed. Please complete all required fields below.
VendorBankDetails.accountInfoDesc: Enter your bank account details exactly as they appear in your bank records.
VendorBankDetails.accountHolderPlaceholder: Full name as per bank records
VendorBankDetails.accountHolderHint: Must exactly match the name registered with your bank.
VendorBankDetails.transferCodesDesc: Provide IFSC for domestic (India) transfers and/or SWIFT/BIC for international payouts.
VendorBankDetails.ifscTooltip: Indian Financial System Code — 11-character code identifying your bank branch. Found on your cheque or passbook. Format: ABCD0123456 (4 letters, 0, 6 alphanumeric).
VendorBankDetails.swiftTooltip: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication code — used for international wire transfers. 8 or 11 characters. Format: HDFCINBBXXX (bank code + country + location + branch).
VendorBankDetails.additionalPaymentDesc: Optional — speeds up instant payouts via UPI.
VendorBankDetails.upiTooltip: Unified Payments Interface ID — e.g. yourname@okaxis, yourphone@paytm. Used for instant domestic payouts.
VendorBankDetails.securityNotice: Important: Ensure all details are absolutely correct. We are not responsible for payments sent to an incorrect account. Changes to bank details will apply to all future payout requests. Your data is securely stored and only accessible by you and our admin team.
